notes.title: Electricity system reworked
notes.content:
It's strange, really: Just a couple of days ago, I started re-playing MagnetoBotty myself and I cannot believe _how many_ bugs I found. 
This time, the level "Circuit" turned out to be impossible -- due to a bug in the electricity system in MagnetoBotty. 

I reworked the system and re-tested all electricity levels (Electro, Elevate, Gears, Bridge, Bronze, Cathedral, Strange, Machine, Spiral, Circuit, Confined, Conductor, and Evil) and -- yes -- now it works as it was intended.
Finally.

Another minor change: There is one block in "Conductor", which looks like a normal wire stone, but is, in fact, not pushable (intentionally so). It is now colored red, so that you can see that it cannot be moved.

Out of curiosity: What's the highest level you completed? (Which ones did you find hardest? Which ones did you like? Did not like? ...) Please do share your impressions. Thanks! 

Most of all:
Have fun!

notes.title: Easy Cathedral
notes.content:
This time, I found a level, which had been too easy. I accidentally left the exit "on" by default, which made completing "Cathedral" way too easy. Now, you'll have to work just a little harder to complete it...

But hey -- where would be the fun otherwise?
(Oh, and in case you're still wondering: Last time, I messed up "Core" -- I lost two stones, so that level became unsolvable).

Have fun!

Sorry about that and happy solving!

notes.title: MagnetoBotty is going to be free!
notes.content:
For the past eight years or so, I've been working a lot and very happily with the Unity game engine. Since I do game programming purely as a hobby, I've never been concerned with the financial aspect; first and foremost, I want a lot of people to play my game and have fun doing it.
MagnetoBotty is quite a niche project that hopefully will appeal to some hardcore puzzle lovers.

However, with the recent changes in Unity's licensing agreements, I now have to distance myself from the engine. I will look for alternatives (currently Godot looks quite promising), but I will not be able to develop MagnetoBotty further in this form.

So: Download it as soon as it's free, have fun with it and a big thank you to all 138 people who bought this game!

Have fun playing!
Philipp

notes.title: Skip Levels!
notes.content:
Did you know that there are 50 levels in MagnetoBotty (well, 50 and a tutorial)?
How many of them have you seen?
Only a few? Because you got "stuck" in a level and didn't get any further?

Don't worry! Now you can "finally" skip levels that seem too hard at the moment. So you can play all 50 levels (yes -- and the tutorial).

Only the last level ("Evil"), is not skippable -- that would be stupid. Then you could see the lavishly produced blockbuster outro without having accomplished anything for it :).

So: Have a look at all levels, try them and -- above all -- have fun!

notes.title: MagnetoBotty V1.2.0 - Small Update
notes.content:
Hey MagnetoBotty players,

after three years, it was finally time for another (albeit small) update.
In the current version, I changed the graphics a little and switched to different renderers, mostly in preparation for a [b]level editor feature[/b] that is due --- at some point... (But not yet).

In addition to that, I fixed some bugs:
[list]
[*] Music volume is turned down when the tutorial speech plays
[*] Privacy Policy link was (temporarily) broken
[*] Some menu items could not be selected with keyboard controls
[/list]

and I also implemented a new help button (which can be removed from the screen), which will display the objective of each level.

=> Have fun playing!!
